# Dragoon's Town 0.28 release notes

## More life around lasting assets

- Direct home and personal-vehicle purchases now receive a short key-handoff moment in their illustrated card.
- Direct estate and fictional-team purchases now receive a brief opening ribbon.
- Direct home, vehicle and estate upgrades receive the same compact visual acknowledgment.
- Low visual activity keeps the effect simple; Full adds a few extra sparkles. Bulk purchases stay immediate and do not queue repeated animations.

## Comfort and compatibility

- Asset moments follow the existing Off/Low/Full and Life pause controls.
- Reduced motion, battery saver, app/background pauses and Android lifecycle pauses stop the new motion.
- The overlays are decorative, hidden from assistive technology and unable to capture taps.
- Existing saves, prices, income, prestige, artwork, Android package and original signing identity remain compatible.
- Real payments and ads remain disabled.

Browser and compatible Android publication will follow only after complete cloud, viewport, mobile-touch, package and signature checks pass. Physical Android 13/Thor testing remains separate and is not claimed by automated verification.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
